```yaml
name: Test BPFtrace Rust Uprobe Tutorial

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-rust-uprobe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Install Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        override: true
    
    - name: Install bpftrace
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace
    
    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/helloworld
      run: |
        cargo build --debug
        ls -la target/debug/
    
    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in helloworld
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/helloworld
      run: |
        nm target/debug/helloworld | grep hello
        objdump -t target/debug/helloworld | grep hello
    
    - name: Build args project in debug mode
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/args
      run: |
        cargo build --debug
        ls -la target/debug/
    
    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in args
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/args
      run: |
        nm target/debug/args | grep hello
        objdump -t target/debug/args | grep hello
    
    - name: Test args binary execution
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/args
      run: |
        timeout 5s ./target/debug/args || true
    
    - name: Test bpftrace attach with wildcard pattern
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/args
      run: |
        # Test that bpftrace can attach using wildcard pattern
        timeout 10s bash -c "
          echo 'Testing bpftrace attach with wildcard pattern...'
          bpftrace -e 'uprobe:./target/debug/args:_ZN10helloworld5hello*' -c './target/debug/args' 2>&1 | head -n 10
        " || true
    
    - name: Verify bpftrace can trace function calls
      working-directory: ./examples/rust/uprobe/args
      run: |
        # Run a quick test to ensure bpftrace can capture the function call
        timeout 5s bash -c "
          echo 'Verifying bpftrace tracing functionality...'
          bpftrace -e 'uprobe:./target/debug/args:_ZN10helloworld5hello*{ printf(\"Function called\\n\"); }' -c './target/debug/args' 2>&1 | grep -q 'Function called' && echo 'SUCCESS: Function tracing works' || echo 'WARNING: Could not verify tracing'
        " || true
```
